sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP SET IF_FLAG = 'T' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND BUYER = 'KRKOLO0105'
sqlMap.select: SELECT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO, A.TYPE, A.VBELN FROM EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP A WHERE IF_FLAG = 'T' AND BUYER = 'KRKOLO0105' ORDER BY CREATE_DATM
SELECT LIFEX, VBELN, LIFNR, LFDAT, TYPE FROM EAI.IF_KOLON_LIKP WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND TYPE = #TYPE# AND IF_FLAG = 'T'

SELECT VBELN, LIFEX, TO_CHAR(POSNR) POSNR, EBELN, TO_CHAR(EBELP) EBELP, MATNR, TO_CHAR(MENGE) MENGE, MEINS, LICHN, SPE_HERKL, HSDAT, STCD2, NAME1, TEXT1, TEXT2 FROM EAI.IF_KOLON_LIPS WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND TYPE = #TYPE#
